mechanism: Ritonavir inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, which are involved in methylphenidate metabolism, potentially increasing methylphenidate plasma concentrations and cardiovascular effects.
action: Monitor for increased stimulant effects (tachycardia, hypertension, arrhythmias); consider methylphenidate dose reduction and more frequent cardiovascular monitoring when used concurrently with ritonavir.
